about: Public index of every signature row registered by src/game/signatures.cpp, generated by tools/native_index.py from src/game/*_sigs.cpp and sdk/status_registry.json; do not edit. hash is _0x plus the first 16 uppercase hex digits of sha256("sco-core:native:" + id), a stable symbolic name, not an address. No pattern, mask, offset or address is recorded. Nothing here has been run in game.

tiers.1: promoted: backs a capability in sdk/status_registry.json sig_rows
tiers.2: resolved-unexposed: a registered row no registry capability names
tiers.3: spike hold: backs a capability with a spike_ref and default OFF
tiers.4: blocked: backs a capability whose evidence_level is blocked
